item.title: Did BRS miss chance to expose turncoat MLAs in RS polls?

item.title: 1st National Lok Adalat in Telangana rescheduled to March 28
item.description: The Telangana State Legal Services Authority (TSLSA) has announced on Thursday that the 1st National Lok Adalat, originally scheduled for March 14, will now be held on March 28 across all courts in the state. item.title: Police arrest three for selling MDMA
item.description: The Hyderabad Central Crime Station team, along with Abids police, apprehended three individuals from Rajasthan who were involved in selling MDMA. Police seized 72 grams of MDMA packets from their possession. The arrested persons are Jog Singh, Chunaram Chaudary, and Amrith Purohit.According to police, the accused were attempting to sell MDMA to customers in Hyderabad. item.title: Gandipet sub-post office to be opened today
item.description: Hyderabad: A new sub post office will commence operations from Friday in Gandipet, under the Hyderabad City Division of the Telangana Circle. A Subrahmanyam, Senior Superintendent of Post Offices, confirmed that the facility, located at the Gandipet Ward Office, will function from 9 am to 5 pm, Monday through Saturday. item.title: Minister Nara Lokesh Praises Honest Students of Venkatagiri School
item.description: Education and IT Minister Nara Lokesh has lauded the honesty of students from Venkatagiri ZP Girls High School in Tirupati district. item.title: Nitish Kumar Declares Lowest Assets Among Rajya Sabha Candidates, RJD’s AD Singh Tops Wealth List
item.description: Bihar CM Nitish Kumar has reported assets worth Rs 1.66 crore in his Rajya Sabha nomination affidavit, the lowest among candidates, while RJD nominee Amarendra Dhari Singh has declared assets of around Rs 243 crore.
